_note: Ensembles have no training_summary.json of their own (they are not a run), so every ensemble submission is recorded here instead. Same fields as a run's `submission` block.

submissions.notes: First ensemble submission. +0.004 over the 0.908 convnext_small_4slot baseline; the val gain (+0.0043) carried to the leaderboard almost exactly.

submissions.runtime: 36.5 s for the 3 public studies = 12.17 s/study. Heavily inflated: model load and CUDA init are amortized over only 3 studies. Even taken at face value the 9h cap fits ~2662 studies against the ~1300 in the real test set, so the rerun has ~2x headroom.
submissions.notes: convnext_small_25d is deliberately absent. 2.5D is a LOADER setting (slice_context: neighbours), so it cannot share member 0's single DICOM decode pass - it would need a second pass to buy +0.0004 on val. predict_dicom_ensemble now rejects it explicitly instead of silently scoring the wrong pixels. Scored 0.913, the best leaderboard result so far: +0.001 over the 3-model. val moved +0.0018 for +0.001 LB, so the gain is real but small and well inside what one more member can be expected to give.
